key_facts: Port-a-cath tips are ideally positioned in the distal superior vena cava or at the cavoatrial junction.
The cavoatrial junction is where the superior vena cava meets the right atrium.
A chest X-ray can show whether the catheter courses smoothly without kinking, looping, or malposition.
Tip position matters because central placement reduces the risk of thrombosis, malfunction, and vessel injury.
